column2: S (a sentence: only its first letter) | L (a label: every word) | K (leave exactly as written)

column3: Take a picture or choose one
only list cards you own and can actually sell;
describe each card honestly: its name, version, condition and price, with real photos where you use your own;
never sell fakes, proxies or reprints as real cards;
keep your store up to date, and mark a card Out Of Stock, Sold or Hidden as soon as it's gone, including when you sell it outside the site;
answer orders, offers and messages in good time, and keep to what you agree with buyers;
follow the laws that apply to your sales.
hide or remove posts, comments, vouches, listings and photos;
lock, block or remove accounts and stores;
change limits such as daily scans.
